description: Manuscript set A with a leaky-abortive burst below replacement (b_R = 0.5 < 1), sweeping signal diffusivity D_s across the outrun threshold (Table 7: D_s,crit ~ 5.95 with the maturation race; § 3.10). Uses the manuscript density cutoff (no infection below V_ext = p_ext, removal at rate 5); without it, stalls restart by non-physical tail tunnelling.

expected.D_s below ~6: wave_fast: the front outruns its own warning and travels at c0 ~ 2.12
expected.D_s above ~6: stall: the primed band reaches the leading edge, the front arrests and then creeps (§ 3.9)
